traces: The requested count is derangements of 8. Inclusion exclusion gives sum k=0..8 (-1)^k binom8k(8-k)! =40320-40320+20160-6720+1680-336+56-8+1=14833. Present formula explanation choose k fixed positions and permute remaining and final.
answer:
A permutation in which no element appears in its original position is called a **derangement**.

Using inclusion–exclusion, choose \(k\) elements to fix in their original positions and arrange the remaining \(8-k\) elements in \((8-k)!\) ways. Thus the number of derangements is
\[
\begin{aligned}
D_8
&=\sum_{k=0}^{8}(-1)^k\binom{8}{k}(8-k)!\\
&=8!\left(1-1+\frac1{2!}-\frac1{3!}+\cdots+\frac1{8!}\right)\\
&=40320-40320+20160-6720+1680-336+56-8+1\\
&=\boxed{14833}.
\end{aligned}
\]
